verdict.rationale: Docs show agent-originated orders flow into the merchant's existing order-management system 'just as it would from any other channel' (Store Sync), settlement runs through the merchant's existing Braintree/PayPal processing relationship via single-use tokens, and standard REST APIs plus webhooks (orders, transactions, disputes, refunds) provide the reporting/reconciliation surface, with the same published fee schedule applying (no separate agentic fee tier). However there is no dedicated documentation of payout timing/settlement reports specific to agent transactions, no reconciliation dashboard or statement-level detail, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of clean reconciliation in practice. Missing for 10: explicit payout/settlement-report documentation for agent transactions, reconciliation dashboard evidence, independent verification of accurate settlement records.
